from pathlib import Path
import datetime, hashlib, json, shutil
root = Path.cwd()
tag = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
restore = root / ".local" / "restores" / "SB2C-admission" / tag
restore.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
(root / ".local" / ".gdignore").touch(exist_ok=True)
evidence = root / "docs/showcase/evidence/SB2C-admission"
evidence.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(evidence / ".gdignore").touch(exist_ok=True)
for name in ("baseline", "final", "logs"):
    (evidence / name).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
owned = [root/"aircraft/sb2c4/sb2c4.gd", root/"aircraft/sb2c4/showcase.gd", root/"aircraft/sb2c4/sb2c4.tscn", root/"aircraft/sb2c4/showcase.tscn", root/"docs/deliveries/sb2c4-delivery.md", root/"docs/references/bombers/sb2c/README.md", root/"docs/references/bombers/sb2c/sources.json", root/"docs/references/bombers/sb2c/modeling-brief.md"]
manifest = {"captured_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), "restore": str(restore), "files": {}}
for p in owned:
    target = restore / p.relative_to(root)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(p, target)
    manifest["files"][str(p.relative_to(root))] = hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for p in (root/"aircraft/scripts/aircraft_builder.gd", root/"project.godot"):
    manifest["files"][str(p.relative_to(root))] = hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
(restore/"manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n")
(evidence/"sources-before.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"restore": str(restore), "evidence": str(evidence), "files": len(manifest["files"])}, ensure_ascii=False))
